messages:
marta: Kicking off the change window now. This thread is the single source for cross-service readiness (API, runtime, console, router). Please ack and call out any blockers.

deploy-bot: deploywave/2026-03-21 started by @marta. Planned canary: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Pin versions where needed.

ben: Ack. Planning to pin api-service v1.14.2 -> will hold if kernel batching flag differs.

lucas: Console front-end: tests green, dashboards updated. I pushed release notes draft: <https://internal.docs.redwood/release/2026-03-21|release notes>.

jia: Runtime: KV cache eviction tweak in v2.3 might be risky. Rollback criteria: 95th p50 latency > 250ms for 3 minutes OR error rate > 1% for 5 minutes on the runtime-canary metric.

marta: Noted. Ben, can you pin api to 1.14.2 for the canary and schedule the header-swap at T+10m?

ben: Doing the pin now. `orchctl pin api-service v1.14.2 --scope=canary`

deploy-bot: canary-stage started: 5% traffic to new variants. Logs: `deploywave/2026-03-21/canary-1`

sre-oncall: Observability baseline collected. I set alerts to strict for the next 30m and will escalate on the thresholds Jia listed.

lucas: Console is following the canary. I see initial telemetry, no console errors yet.

jia: Runtime canary reporting: 95th p50 = 180ms, error rate 0.12% — within bounds. Proceeding to 20% in 8m unless anyone objects.

marta: No objections from me. Proceed. Remember rollback command and windows: emergency rollback goes to previous stable pinned set.

ben: Confirmed pinned stable: api-service v1.14.1. If we need rollback: run
```
deploy-bot rollback --wave=2026-03-21 --to=stable --force
```

lucas: FYI console will hold any schema-mismatch errors; I’ll flip feature gate if needed.

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 20% (T+10m). Monitor: runtime-canary, api-5xx, console-js-errors.

jia: Seeing small spike in runtime tail latency on a single shard, digging in. If it hits threshold I recommend immediate pause and rollback.

marta: If pause happens, we execute the rollback command and trigger the postmortem stub. Keep messages here succinct.

sre-oncall: Alert channel ready; I’ll ping infra if it’s a rollback.

ben: All good to continue from my side. Pin and release notes updated. :thumbsup:

lucas: :thumbsup: console green.

jia: :thumbsup: runtime stable so far. watching that shard.

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% (T+25m). No automatic rollbacks triggered.

marta: Thanks everyone. Final step: full traffic to follow at T+40m if no regressions. I’ll post a final go/no-go at T+35m.

sre-oncall: Acknowledge. I’ll keep an eye and post any alerts here.

marta: Closing note — please update the release notes link with any post-rollout caveats.
